feedback.text: Correct — two link fields, one per direction.

questiontext.text: To visit every nonzero in one column, you follow...

feedback.text: Correct — the down-links thread all nonzeros of a column.

generalfeedback.text: Row lists use right-links; column lists use down-links. Pick the link that matches the direction you traverse.

questiontext.text: The orthogonal linked-list matrix is especially good for...

answer.text: very sparse matrices that change dynamically

feedback.text: Correct — nodes are cheap to insert and delete by relinking.

answer.text: dense matrices needing O(1) random access

feedback.text: Linked lists give no O(1) random access; a dense array is better.

generalfeedback.text: Dynamic insert/delete via relinking makes the orthogonal list ideal for changing, very sparse matrices.
